session: Split supplied sessionId on eventdate change or >1200000ms inter-event gap in combined query/view/click/purchase timeline
history: All catalogued events strictly earlier than query, within current episode and <=1200000ms lookback; current query clicks excluded
sampling: Nested whole sub-sessions stratified by split/calendar week/total event length bucket/identity availability/click existence; midpoint seeded ranks
zero_click: Kept and separately reported; relevance summaries and selection condition on >=1 observed clicked candidate; ILD is also reported on zero-click slice
training: LambdaMART, binary naive versus graded view/click/purchase gains 1/2/4 with SkipAbove weights; unseen weights 0 or .2; 15/31/63 leaves; identity ablation; filtered and token-similar history substitution controls
purchase_attribution: Upgrade a query-clicked candidate only for a later same-episode purchase before next query and within 20m; future candidate views in that interval are weak training positives only
model_selection: Maximize validation NDCG, then calibrated recall; 10% development selects tau/delta/training configuration; selected configuration is retrained at all four training scales and validated on the same 10% validation episodes
policy_selection: Maximize validation ILD with <=1% relative loss in BOTH NDCG and calibrated Recall versus selected relevance-only model; separately choose each family and floor
controllers: Fixed lambda; session-diversity median threshold; monotone continuous diversity mapping; learned depth-2 validation controller with internal session split; history-count gate control
bootstrap: 1000 paired resamples of raw sessionId clusters, query-weighted means; 95% percentile intervals, exploratory comparisons without multiplicity correction
confirmation_rule: Freeze model and policy hashes before scoring reserved confirmation outcomes; no retuning on confirmation
limitations: SkipAbove is an exposure heuristic, not an identified propensity model. Offline logs cannot establish causal off-policy reward or benefit of interactive clarification. Raw timeframe units and behavioural narrative remain assumptions tested as recorded numeric windows. Historical archive remains fixed across scales; scale is supervised training-data fraction, not total-data ingestion fraction.
